verdict.rationale: Khoj is fundamentally natural-language-driven: chat interface, natural-language search, slash commands, voice chat, and agent personas all operate via conversational/NL commands across multiple clients (web, Emacs, Obsidian, WhatsApp, desktop). Community evidence corroborates chat and search functioning as described, though with some quality caveats for non-English search. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of agentic command robustness at scale, and no formal API/agent spec (openapi probe 404s) to confirm structured NL-command interface.
